L
CENTRAL POLICE Station.
1st November, 1917.
REPORT ON Attached Leaflets.
Made by D.S.I.Brewster.    Forwarded by Chief Detective Inspector.
Sir,
    Attached are five copies of libellous leaflets which were found in the room which E. M. Berthel uses as his bedroom on the top floor of the drug store at 584 Foochow Road when a search of the place was made at 4 p.m. on the 29th October 1917 by D.S. Givens, Mr. McRae, the United States Court Marshal, and myself on the occasion of the arrest of Berthel for dealing in false passports.
    When the leaflets were found, Berthel said they were his personal property, that they were the only ones left in Shanghai with the exception of one in the possession of Mr. Pkillips, the rest being in the United States.

                                Your obedient servant,
                                W Brewster
                                Detective Sub_Inspector.
Chief Detective Inspector.

L
中央巡捕房。
1917年11月1日。
关于所附传单的报告。
由副督察布鲁斯特 (D.S.I. Brewster) 呈报。经首席侦探督察转呈。
敬启者，
    随函附上五份诽谤性传单副本，这些传单是在1917年10月29日下午4时，副督察吉文斯 (D.S. Givens)、美国法院法警麦克雷先生 (Mr. McRae) 以及本人搜查福州路584号药店顶层 E. M. 贝特尔 (E. M. Berthel) 用作卧室的房间时发现的，当时贝特尔因买卖假护照而被捕。
    发现这些传单时，贝特尔称它们是他的个人财产，并称除了菲利普斯先生 (Mr. Pkillips) 持有一份外，这是上海仅存的几份，其余均在美国。

                                您忠实的仆人，
                                W. 布鲁斯特
                                副侦探督察。
首席侦探督察。

Form 2    34
Shanghai Municipal Police.
C. I D.
I. O. REG
No. 1549
Date 1-11-19
CENTRAL POLICE Station.
24th October, 1917.
REPORT ON Berthel and the False Passport Traffic.
Made by D.S.Givens. Forwarded by Chief Detective Inspector
Sir,
I beg to report that I have further questioned the manager and employes of the May Sun Printing Co., No. 585 Foochow Road, regarding false passports. While admitting having made spurious Spanish passports for Kindler, they assure me they never did any printing of any kind whatever for Berthel and never made or ordered chops on his behalf. Their printer, who dealt directly with Kindler, cannot now be located. A sharp look out is being kept for this man, but he is not likely to be able to throw any new light on the subject under investigation.
Enquiries show that Berthel's printing is done by the China Publishing and Printing Co., No. 21 Foochow Road, a branch of the Commercial Press. The employes of this establishment have been shown photographs and specimens of the documents, which Berthel is alleged to have prepared. They say they never printed such matters. They admit, however, having printed for Berthel, a pamphlet libelling the British Consul. I am attaching a copy of this, and a statement from the late manager of the China Publishing and Printing Co. describing how he came to print it.
（批：Shown to Mr. B... Oct 25 ...）
I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
J.H.Givens,
Detective Sergeant.
C. D. I.

中央巡捕房。
1917年10月24日。
关于贝特尔及假护照交易的报告。
由副督察吉文斯 (D.S. Givens) 呈报。经首席侦探督察转呈。
敬启者，
    谨此报告，我就假护照一事进一步讯问了福州路585号美生印刷公司 (May Sun Printing Co.) 的经理及雇员。他们承认曾为金德勒 (Kindler) 制作虚假的西班牙护照，但向我保证，他们从未为贝特尔进行过任何形式的印刷，也从未代表他制作或订购过印章。直接与金德勒接洽的那名印刷工目前下落不明。正在严密搜寻此人，但他不太可能为正在调查的案件提供新的线索。
    调查显示，贝特尔的印刷业务是由福州路21号的中国出版印刷公司 (China Publishing and Printing Co.) 承办的，该公司是商务印书馆的一家分支机构。已向该机构的雇员展示了据称由贝特尔编制的文件照片及样本。他们表示从未印刷过此类物品。然而，他们承认曾为贝特尔印刷过一本诽谤英国领事的小册子。现附上该小册子的一份副本，以及中国出版印刷公司前任经理的一份陈述，说明他是如何承印该小册子的。
（批注：于10月25日向 B... 先生展示 ...）
    敬上，
    您忠实的仆人，
    J.H. 吉文斯，
    侦探警长。
    首席侦探督察。

Form 63
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 1549
Date 1-11-17
The following is the statement of Woo Ping Chien (吳秉銓 )
native of Shaoshing, Chekiang, taken by me (D.S.Givens)
at 11.35 a.m. on the Oct. 24th, 1917, and interpreted by Loh.

I am employed by the Commercial Press, and was manager
of their branch called The China Publishing and Printing Co.
at No. 21 Foochow Road until March 1917. In January of
that year, I was called to a pharmacy on Foochow Road
opposite the Central Police Station, where I met a tall
foreigner named E. M. Berthel, whose brother C. Berthel I
had known for 10 years. The tall foreigner He then handed me several sheets
of handwriting matter and ordered me to print it for him.
I asked Berthel how many copies he wanted, and he said he
wished to have several hundred at least, and not more than
a thousand. Four days afterwards, I sent a coolie with
the proof to Berthel's shop, and he made some corrections.
This was repeated three or four times. When the proof was
O.K., Berthel ordered 600 copies, for which he paid $10.00.
I identify the document shown to me regarding the Vagaries
of a British Consul as the one which was printed in my
shop on Berthel's behalf.

Signed by P. C. Woo 吳秉銓
In the presence of D.S.Givens
D.S.

情报登记 (I. O. REG)

以下为吴秉銓 (Woo Ping Chien) 的陈述，
浙江绍兴人，由本人（副督察吉文斯）于1917年10月24日上午11时35分录取，由罗 (Loh) 担任翻译。

    我受雇于商务印书馆，并担任其分支机构——位于福州路21号的中国出版印刷公司——的经理，直至1917年3月。同年1月，我被叫到福州路中央巡捕房对面的一家药房，在那里我遇到了一位名叫 E. M. 贝特尔 (E. M. Berthel) 的高个子外国人，我曾认识他的兄弟 C. 贝特尔 (C. Berthel) 十年之久。那位高个子外国人随后递给我几页手写稿件，并命令我为他印刷。我问贝特尔需要多少份，他说至少需要几百份，不超过一千份。四天后，我派一名苦力将校样送到贝特尔的店铺，他做了一些修改。这一过程重复了三四次。当校样确认后，贝特尔订购了600份，为此支付了10.00美元。我确认向我展示的关于《一位英国领事的怪癖》(Vagaries of a British Consul) 的文件，就是在我店里代表贝特尔印刷的那一份。

    吴秉銓 签字
    在副督察吉文斯面前
    副督察
